discipline.rule: Each studied discipline/module is represented as a separate row with one intermediate-attestation grade in the third column.

practice.rule: Each practice is represented on a separate row with its intermediate-attestation grade; the aggregate Practices row has x instead of a grade.

gia.rule: Each state-final-attestation test is represented on a separate row with its grade; the aggregate GIA row has x instead of a grade.

courseWork.rule: Each course work/project is represented separately with its grade.

facultative.rule: Facultative disciplines may be included in the supplement with graduate consent; honors-percentage treatment depends on organization policy.

gradeWriting.rule: Grades are written in words: отлично, хорошо, удовлетворительно, зачтено.

hubInterpretation.currentIU5Facultatives: present but pure credit; excluded from baseline projection until organization policy is verified
